response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT COALESCE(TRIM(p.bats),'') AS bats, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM player_award pa JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(TRIM(p.bats),'')), s AS (SELECT bats, award_count, award_count * 1.0 / SUM(award_count) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT s.*, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT bats, award_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_above_average FROM a WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share DESC

assumptions.assumption: Blank (empty or whitespace-only) and NULL bats are merged into one group represented by an empty string.
The total for share is the count of player_award rows that match a player (inner join), and the average is the simple mean of per-hand shares, including the blank group.
Each player_award row counts as one award record, including tied or duplicate-looking rows.
